stories.title: Binance outflows settle after reopening; full proof of reserves now due by Tuesday
stories.summary: Binance reopened withdrawals on Sunday after the 29 Oct hack. By its own count, about $3.64B more left than came in during the first nine and a half hours, about 2.1% of the $171B it held. It says volumes are stabilising and deposits remain substantial. Its zero-knowledge proof of reserves (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) is now promised by Tuesday 3 Nov (UTC).
points: Binance's figures, 06:00-15:30 UTC Sunday: $4.65B withdrawn, $1.01B deposited, net about $3.64B, per The Block.

Outside trackers differ: DefiLlama showed a $4.05B 24-hour net outflow, per The Block. Its 24-hour window began more than 13 hours before withdrawals reopened and it tracks about $131B of Binance wallets, per Coindoo.
Most coins are still waiting: withdrawals were still suspended for 531 of 552 coins on Sunday morning US time, per The Block.
Binance says company funds have now covered 95% of the stolen amount, up from 80% on Friday and 90% on Saturday, per Brad Feld's tracker.
The full proof takes 40 to 50 hours of computing, so Binance moved it from Monday to Tuesday 3 Nov (UTC), per Brad Feld.

stories.title: North Korea money trail: $242M laundered through Tron routes as FBI presses swap services
stories.summary: The hackers keep converting stolen coins and moving them through decentralized swap services, which makes them harder to freeze. The FBI has asked THORChain node operators and other services to block listed addresses; the request is voluntary. Elliptic says $2.85B is frozen or seized, but about $3.25B sits in assets that cannot be frozen.
points: Elliptic, via The Block: $2.85B frozen or seized, about 44% of the $6.43B stolen; about $3.25B in unfreezable assets, including 18,327 BTC.
About $242M of Binance loot on Tron was laundered in two days through Relay, THORChain, Chainflip and Symbiosis, per an analyst cited by The Block. Tether froze 378.7M USDT of it.
Digital Today, citing The Defiant and Chainalysis, says more than $500M moved first on Tron through over 1,000 addresses before activity spread to Solana and other chains.
Separately, THORChain paused swaps on 12 of its 13 chains for hours after a glitch caused a 10 ETH double refund; no attack was found, per Bitcoin.com News.

stories.title: Quiet market heads into Tuesday's midterms; crypto industry spent over $170M
stories.summary: Bitcoin spent Sunday near $78,000 while traders waited for Tuesday's US midterm elections, which decide who writes the next round of crypto rules. Investors pulled money from crypto funds on the last trading day of October.
points: Bitcoin was about $77,804 in a crypto.news report published at 13:45 UTC Sunday. Live prices are at the top of this page.
Spot bitcoin ETFs lost $643.2M on Friday 30 Oct, their biggest daily outflow of October; spot ether ETFs lost $155.7M, a fifth straight day of outflows, per Decrypt.
The crypto industry has spent over $170M on the election, mostly through Fairshake, including over $60M against Sherrod Brown in Ohio, per CoinDesk.
The CLARITY Act, the main crypto market bill, failed to advance out of the Senate last month, per CoinDesk. Results may take days.

briefs.title: China targets crypto corruption
briefs.summary: A Communist Party resolution published 1 Nov orders a crackdown on corruption through virtual currency and blockchain; it adds no new trading ban, per crypto.news.
